item.subject: science
item.stem:
Indira studies four pure samples: distilled water, made of identical molecules each containing hydrogen and oxygen; oxygen gas, made of identical molecules each containing only oxygen; carbon dioxide gas, made of identical molecules each containing carbon and oxygen; and sugar crystals, made of molecules containing carbon, hydrogen and oxygen. An element is a pure substance made of only one kind of identical particle.

Which sample should she classify as an element?

options.A: Distilled water, made of identical molecules each containing hydrogen and oxygen.
options.B: Oxygen gas, made of identical molecules each containing only oxygen.
options.C: Carbon dioxide gas, made of identical molecules each containing carbon and oxygen.
options.D: Sugar crystals, made of molecules containing carbon, hydrogen and oxygen.
